signoff.note: Fresh reviewer (not drawer, not filler). Read all 30 entries against the stored captures: the 11 readable entries' listed names were checked on their pages (Mossel, Manxi Wu, Tripakis, Sahai, Sturmfels, Wilkening, Sreenath, Horowitz, Karandikar, Yi Ma, Walrand) and found genuine and strict-rule compliant, no names missed; the 19 unverifiable entries were checked against the capture store. Corrections (each in the entry notes as REVIEW 1125): Shewchuk, Nuzzo and Holmes relabelled readable (a stored page with a member list existed; filler called it unreachable or missed it); Borgs and O'Brien reasons corrected to no_member_list_page; Culler reason to list_not_current; Giantamidis (Tripakis) gained same-line outside_school evidence. Not relabelled, flagged for the owner: Pachter (stored Caltech group page, Berkeley names not separable without unproven exclusions). Unverifiable entries not otherwise contradicted by a stored page were taken as the filler recorded them (live people.eecs host blocked after HTTP 403, robots-blocked lab sites); no additional pages were captured (one attempt, Walrand's Google Site, returned a 302). Sample, seed and binds untouched. Recall bars are as the checker computes them.
